The '''Aldera Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The spaceport tended to attract the "seedier element."<ref name="CatCW" />
